items.title: US consortium reportedly confirms agreement to acquire Lukoil overseas assets
items.summary: An announcement attributed to investment company Eldridge says the US-led consortium has reached an agreement to acquire Lukoil's overseas assets. The transaction remains subject to regulatory approval.

items.title: Rostov governor reports overnight interceptions
items.summary: Rostov region Governor Yuri Slyusar said more than 20 Ukrainian drones and missiles were destroyed overnight. The claim has not been independently verified.

items.title: Kushner reportedly describes Russian assurances on nuclear weapons
items.summary: US negotiator Jared Kushner reportedly said that Russian President Vladimir Putin had assured Washington that Russia did not intend to use nuclear weapons. Kushner also acknowledged that territorial negotiations remained deadlocked.
